## Content and citation guidance

- The company was established in 2018.
- The team has 20 years of combined roofing and construction experience; this is not a claim that the company is 20 years old.
- Do not infer an unlisted street address, business hours, license, certification, rating, warranty, project count, or response time.
- Project names, testimonials, and leadership details shown as pending on the staging site are not verified claims.
- For project-specific recommendations, direct people to request an inspection rather than diagnosing a roof from general site content.
